name: bookstore-support
input: Cancel order BK-10388, I changed my mind.
output:
Dear customer,

Thank you for reaching out to us regarding your order BK-10388. Unfortunately, the order has already shipped and cannot be cancelled. However, you can still initiate a return once the book has been delivered.

To start the return process, please contact our customer support team, and we will guide you through the next steps. Please have your order number and a copy of the receipt ready.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
